# Retain application logs for fourteen days

## Context and Problem Statement

Application logs are the largest class by volume and the least useful once an
incident is closed.

## Decision Outcome

Application logs are retained for fourteen days, then deleted.

## Consequences

Storage for this class stays roughly flat. Investigations older than two weeks
have to rely on metrics and traces instead.
